title: Bacalhau with chickpeas, egg and parsley
steps: Soak the salt cod for 24–48 hours according to the packet, changing the water several times, or buy desalted bacalhau.
Poach the fish in simmering water for 8–10 minutes, drain and flake into large pieces; boil the eggs for 9 minutes.
Rinse the chickpeas and warm them briefly, slice the onion into thin rings and chop the garlic.
Toss everything with the oil, vinegar, pepper and parsley and serve with egg quarters and olives.
